name: Le Meridien Angkor
insider_take: This sophisticated sanctuary sits just minutes from the legendary Angkor Archaeological Park, where French elegance meets ancient Khmer grandeur in perfect harmony.
whats_special: Le Meridien Angkor is uniquely positioned as the closest luxury hotel to the UNESCO World Heritage Angkor temples. The property features original Khmer architecture blended with contemporary French design, plus it's home to one of Cambodia's most acclaimed spas offering traditional Khmer healing treatments.
pro_tip: Book the sunrise Angkor Wat tour through the hotel - they provide early morning refreshments and have exclusive access routes that bypass the crowds for those magical golden hour photos.
dont_miss: The hotel's Salt Bar offers panoramic views of the ancient Angkor Thom walls, while the pool area features stunning views of pre-Angkorian ruins. Visit the nearby Artisans Angkor workshop (5-minute walk) to watch traditional silk weaving and stone carving techniques unchanged for centuries.
pros: Prime location near Angkor Wat temples and Old Market
Beautiful resort-style property with lush tropical gardens
Excellent spa facilities and wellness amenities
Multiple dining options featuring local and international cuisine
cons: Premium pricing for Siem Reap market
Can be busy during peak tourist seasons
